notice: VOLT is a fictional electric vehicle brand created for a design portfolio. Vehicles, specifications and prices are illustrative concepts, not verified real-world figures, and nothing on this site can be ordered.

hero.text: A quiet, electric fastback designed around light, air and the driver.

showcase.title: VOLT ONE
showcase.text: Long, low and calm. One continuous surface from the light bar to the tail, a glass cabin that seems to float, and a dual-motor drivetrain that stays silent until you ask for more.

hotspots.label: Light signature
hotspots.text: A single 2 mm light bar runs the full width of the nose. It greets you, signals and shows the charge level.

hotspots.label: Aero wheels
hotspots.text: Covered 20-inch wheels smooth the air along the sides. Choose a more open design in the configurator.

hotspots.label: Floating cabin
hotspots.text: Blacked-out pillars make the glass canopy read as one piece, with a full glass roof above.

story.title: One line, front to back.
story.text: The body is drawn as a single line that rises over the front wheels, runs flat along the shoulder and falls away into a short tail. No creases that don't do a job.

story.title: Shaped by moving air.
story.text: Air enters through a slot under the light bar, cools the battery and leaves through the wheel arches. Flush glass, covered wheels and a sharp tail help the car slip through the air.

story.title: A signature, not a lamp.
story.text: Full-width light bars front and rear, each made of 480 individually controlled LEDs. They animate when you approach, pulse while charging and dim in traffic.

story.title: Quiet by design.
story.text: A low, wide dashboard, a floor without a tunnel and seats wrapped in your choice of leather, vegan leather or wool-blend textile. Double glazing keeps road noise out.

story.title: Information where your eyes already are.
story.text: Speed and navigation float in the head-up display. A slim 15-inch screen handles everything else, with physical controls kept for the things you use most.

energy.title: Charging, explained.
energy.text: The battery sits flat under the floor as part of the structure. An 800-volt system lets it accept high charging power for longer, so stops stay short.

modules.label: Prismatic cells
modules.text: Large cells packed directly into the pack without separate modules, so more of the space holds energy.

modules.label: Cooling plate
modules.text: A liquid-cooled plate under the cells keeps them at the right temperature while charging and driving.

modules.label: Battery management
modules.text: Monitors every cell, balances charge and plans pre-conditioning when you navigate to a charger.

modules.label: Structural case
modules.text: The aluminium case is part of the body, which stiffens the car and lowers its centre of gravity.

philosophy.title: Use less, then charge less
philosophy.text: Efficiency comes first: low drag, efficient motors and a heat pump, so each kilowatt-hour goes further.

philosophy.title: Built to be repaired
philosophy.text: The pack is designed so individual parts can be replaced, rather than changing the whole battery.

philosophy.title: Honest numbers
philosophy.text: Every figure here is a concept target for a fictional car. Real-world range depends on speed, weather, wheels and load.
